attempted_claim: Condensation completion and framed skein completion do not commute on 2Vect_{Z/2 x Z/2}: Cond(SkFr(C)) has strictly larger Grothendieck rank and a Lagrangian etale algebra with no counterpart in SkFr(Cond(C)), witnessed by an explicit skein-loop condensation channel created only when skein completion is applied first.
claim_type: non-commutation theorem for two completion operations
decisive_failure: The investigation was halted at the definitional stage: framed skein completion SkFr has no located definition as a fusion-2-category endofunctor, and the condensation side collapses on the fixed input under standard completeness definitions. No rank or algebra comparison could therefore be computed, and no emergent finding was claimed.
